regression.implementation: NumPy float64 ridge normal equations; no additional dependency
regression.objective: sum((y - intercept - X_standardized @ coefficients)**2) + alpha * sum(coefficients**2)
regression.standardization: training-fold column mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0)
regression.constant_columns: standard deviation <= 1e-12 replaced by 1; centered constant training columns become zero
regression.evaluation: leave one entire source video out; same folds for all four predictors
regression.tuning: none; fixed alpha=1.0 specified before evaluation
regression.primary_predictions: clip raw held-out predictions to [0,2] for all metrics
regression.spearman: Pearson correlation of average ranks for ties; undefined if either vector is constant
regression.aggregation: calculate each metric per video, then give videos equal weight
